paragraphs: Yochanan ben Narbai, High Priest; Pesachim 57a. And in Keritot 28a the reading is Yochanan ben Nadbai.[^1]

notes.text: כה״ג is read contextually as High Priest, a source office rather than an added personal rabbinic title. נז., and כח. give Pesachim 57a and Keritot 28a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. Narbai and Nadbai remain the different readings Hyman attributes to those texts; neither is harmonized or bound to an identity.
